note: Hand-transcribed extract of PATO sex terms for engineering tests; definitions paraphrased, not quoted. Verify against the official PATO release before any research use.

terms.label: biological sex
terms.definition: An organismal quality inhering in an organism by virtue of its reproductive role.

terms.label: phenotypic sex
terms.definition: Biological sex as determined by the organism's phenotype.

terms.label: female
terms.definition: Phenotypic sex of an organism that produces ova.

terms.label: male
terms.definition: Phenotypic sex of an organism that produces spermatozoa.
